Name: Hisame's New Craftables
Author: hisameartwork
Description:
This mod adds animal statues and Flower pots to be purchased at Summer Market and Fish Food to be used on Goldfish Bowl and Koi tank. Also adds two new crafting recipes you can purchase from Krobus (Void Poison and Love Potion).

A huge thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/64051321]Fwippy [/url]for converting the pots to seasonal and Emie Stardew for donating some of the textures.

To see the market you can check here:
[youtube]nCackNsOFbw[/youtube]

And if you wish to help us with code or art feel free to drop by in my [url=https://discord.gg/Q5MeNHX]Discord server[/url]﻿. ^_^ 
Cheers!
[url=https://hisameartwork.wordpress.com/]Hisame[/url]

Downloads.Description: Flower Pots are now seasonal as they were intended to be since beginning.
